pathology_report:
Biopsy Timepoint 1:
Histological examination of the prostate tissue reveals acinar adenocarcinoma. The Gleason score is 3+3, corresponding to ISUP grade group 1. No cribriform or intraductal patterns identified. Perineural invasion is not present. The tumour is located in the peripheral zone, apex left.

Biopsy Timepoint 2:
Histological examination of the prostate tissue reveals acinar adenocarcinoma. The Gleason score is 3+4, corresponding to ISUP grade group 2. No cribriform or intraductal patterns identified. Perineural invasion is not present. The tumour is located in the peripheral zone, apex left.

Summary:
The histological trajectory across timepoints demonstrates an upgrade from ISUP grade group 1 to ISUP grade group 2.
